title: Vibe Tracks runs per track per day (real, 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-26)
source: runs_daily.json (source/build_series.py, real) + verdict derived from pass_rate by source/build_days.py

track_title.note: The track, as vt state titles it.

day.note: The run's local date in Vancouver (America/Vancouver). Every day of the window is present, empty days with 0 runs.

runs.note: Runs in the track's producers' runs_table.jsonl that day: every run, benches included.

judged_runs.note: Of those, runs that carry a pass/fail verdict: ruckig labels.ok; spec runs failed == 0; fivebar checks_fail + checks_error == 0; pyblocks runnable_red == 0; tycoon-crm gates_fail == 0. Timing and coverage benches carry none.

passed_runs.note: Judged runs whose verdict is pass.

pass_rate.note: passed_runs / judged_runs (derived, n = judged runs); null with the reason on a day with no verdict.

producers.note: The producer folders counted for the track.

verdict.label: Verdict
verdict.note: Derived by source/build_days.py from pass_rate: pass (every judged run passed), fail (none passed), mixed (some), none (no judged run that day).
